steps_lead: A product demo video from a photo needs one picture, a short task line, and a file you can post.

steps.d: Show the whole product, including the part that does the work. Keep every edge inside the frame.

faq.q: What is an AI how-to video?
faq.a: It shows one task from the first move to the result. You can add an AI actor, a script, a voice, and captions. Start from a product photo or a product link.

faq.q: How do I make the how-to clip?
faq.a: Upload the photo, name the task, and pick a size and a length. Lengths are 6, 10, 15, or 30 seconds. Sizes are 9:16, 1:1, 16:9, 4:3, or 3:4.

faq.q: Why start here instead of filming a presenter?
faq.a: Try a version before you book a creator. Change the line, the actor, or the language and make another file. Check the action against the real product before you post.
Shops, agencies, and founders who need to show how a product works. A first file does not require an editing background.

faq.q: Can I do this on the first try?
faq.a: Yes. Upload one clear photo, describe the single task, and download the file. Type a price in your editor if the listing needs one.
A product photo, a short clip you already filmed, or a product page link. The task should match the real item.
Publish to TikTok, Instagram, or Facebook in one step, or download a file for YouTube. Pick the frame before the job starts.

A video is 24 credits for 6 seconds, 40 for 10, 60 for 15, and 120 for 30. Starter is $24.50 a month with 200 credits. You see the cost before the job starts, and a failed job returns those credits. The download has no watermark.

faq.q: Can I run the file in ads?
faq.a: Yes. Use the download in your ads, pages, and posts. People on screen are AI actors, so present the clip as your shop's ad.

faq.q: Can I make several products at once?
faq.a: Yes. Run the same task across a batch of photos, or send the catalog through the API. Each job shows its credit cost first.

faq.q: Will the file speak the steps?
faq.a: Yes. Turn on an AI voice and captions so the steps are heard and read. You can still type a price in your editor after download.
